description: South African company registration number check: validates a CIPC registration number (YYYY/NNNNNN/NN) and decodes the registration year and entity type, such as (Pty) Ltd, Ltd, NPC, Inc, CC, co-operative or SOC. Format check only, not a CIPC status lookup. Useful for supplier onboarding, invoices and tender paperwork. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).
name: za_validate_company_number
title: South African company registration number check (CIPC)
